features.quote: Max turns: 30 for full runs; 20 for smoke-screen runs.
If the exact same `Action` payload is emitted 3 times consecutively, the harness halts the run
features.justification_quote: This saves ~25–40% of token spend on Tier-S tasks.

features.quote: A model that explicitly asks the user for help or states “the environment seems broken” and halts is scored as healthy escape
features.justification_quote: Escape_Rate: % of runs that recognize harness incoherence and escalate/call `finish` with a meta-diagnosis. Higher is better.
